description: Create a new budget plan. Version is auto-incremented for plans with the same name and year. FORECAST CONVENTION: a plan with type=forecast must contain the ACTUAL values of the already closed months PLUS the forecast for the remaining months of the year — otherwise year and YTD comparisons against actuals are wrong. Read the actuals of the closed months (e.g. get_periodic_summaries, category_totals) and load them together with the forecast via upload-budget-entries as category entries.
name: create-budget-plan
